nodes.name: build-impl.xml
nodes.summary: NetBeans-generated Ant build implementation containing macrodefs and targets for initialization, compilation (with module/processor support), JAR creation, execution, debugging, Javadoc generation, test compilation/execution (JUnit 4 and TestNG), profiling, and cleanup. Defines the complete build lifecycle for the testNET project.
nodes.languageNotes: XML with Ant macros and NetBeans-specific namespaces; generated from project.xml — do not edit directly

nodes.name: genfiles.properties
nodes.summary: Tracks CRC32 checksums of generated files (build.xml, build-impl.xml data/script/stylesheet) to detect when NetBeans should regenerate build-impl.xml from project.xml.
nodes.languageNotes: Java properties file with CRC32 hashes

nodes.name: project.properties
nodes.summary: Main NetBeans project configuration defining source/test directories, Java 1.8 target, classpath references to five external JARs (AIZero, ifOS, OS, Zero, testFS), main class AI.Models.CPU, output JAR at dist/testNET.jar, and JUnit 4 as test framework.
nodes.languageNotes: Java properties file; references external projects via relative paths

nodes.name: project.xml
nodes.summary: NetBeans project metadata declaring project type (j2seproject), source root (src.dir), test root (test.src.dir), and five external project references (AIZero, OS, Zero, ifOS, testFS) as JAR dependencies with build/clean targets.

edges.detail: build-impl.xml loads project.properties for build configuration (javac.classpath, src.dir, dist.jar, etc.)
build-impl.xml is generated from project.xml per the header comment
project.properties expands references declared in project.xml (e.g., reference.ifOS.jar)
genfiles.properties tracks build-impl.xml checksums for regeneration
Defines dist.jar output path and main class AI.Models.CPU
Contains jar target that produces the output JAR
Compiles sources from src.dir (defined in project.properties)
Compiles and runs tests from test.src.dir using JUnit 4/TestNG
Project metadata source for generated build implementation
